description: Convert between px, rem, em, %, pt, in, cm, mm, vw, vh and more — with live viewport and font-size context.

faqs.a: Every unit is converted through an absolute pixel value first: absolute units use fixed ratios (1in = 96px), relative units use your root/parent font size or the live viewport dimensions.
vw/vh/vmin/vmax are read live from window.innerWidth/innerHeight, so they reflect your actual browser window.
faqs.q: Where do vw and vh values come from?

faqs.a: ex and ch depend on the font in use; the tool uses the common approximations ex ≈ 0.5em and ch ≈ 0.5em and labels them as such.
faqs.q: How accurate are ex and ch?

faqs.a: Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Enter a value and pick the source unit.
Pick the target unit — the result updates live.
Adjust root/parent font size for accurate relative conversions.
title: CSS Unit Converter
